lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li12Fe4Se4S8 (reduced formula Li3FeSeS2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 28 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe centers coordinated by six S neighbors, while Li and Se centers adopt octahedral environments with six S neighbors each. The analysis also reveals corner-sharing between Li and Se octahedra, and both corner- and edge-sharing between Li octahedra. A single three-dimensional geometric neighbor graph spans all 28 sites.
